refusals.reason: qdot's 3-, 5- and 6-bit loops advance x_thread cumulatively, so with D / 4 values per lane they read past the lane's x_thread array; out-of-bounds pointer arithmetic is undefined in the C++14 the Metal Shading Language builds on ([expr.add]), and no host path dispatches these instantiations

validationContract.model: qmv_quad_impl lane by lane after adjust_matrix_offsets: each quad's eight rows eight apart, every lane's quarter of K through load_vector and qdot, the row guard after each row's scale and bias loads, quad_sum and lane 0's static_cast stores, against direct dequantized dot products
validationContract.packing: least-significant-bit-first code stream per weight row
validationContract.runtimeEntries: power-of-two widths whose group size divides D; quantize needs K to be a multiple of the group size, and dispatch_qmv sends no other width to qmv_quad
validationContract.inputs: x in quarters of [-1, 1], codes with 0 and the top code in every group, scales +-2^e with e in [-3, 0] and biases -a * scale
validationContract.overreadPadding: scales and biases continue with poison through the last tile's rows, which load them before the row guard
validationContract.exactness: every float32 intermediate is a multiple of 2^-5 below 2^19 in magnitude; only static_cast<T> rounds, to nearest even

softwareSubgroups.quadSum: four consecutive invocations, added in lane order

excludedEntries.reason: the gather_qmm_rhs matrix-matrix kernels are not gated yet
